questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the <caption> element in an HTML table?
options: To provide a visual and accessible title describing the table
To calculate row totals with JavaScript
questions.hint: It labels what the table represents.
questions.explanation: <caption> provides an accessible title describing the purpose and contents of the table.

questions.question: Which attribute on <th> tells screen readers whether a header applies to a column or row?
questions.explanation: The scope attribute explicitly designates whether a header cell is for a column (scope="col") or a row (scope="row").

questions.question: Which attribute merges a single table cell horizontally across 2 columns?
questions.explanation: colspan merges the current cell horizontally across the specified number of columns.

questions.question: Which three elements represent the primary structural sections of an accessible HTML table?
questions.hint: Head, body, and foot for tables.
questions.explanation: <thead>, <tbody>, and <tfoot> segment tables into header, body, and footer summary sections.

questions.question: What is the key difference between <th> and <td>?
options: <th> is for header cells (bold/centered by default), while <td> is for data cells
<th> is used in CSS, while <td> is used in HTML
<th> is a void element, while <td> requires a closing tag
questions.explanation: <th> defines a header cell representing a category or descriptor, while <td> defines standard tabular data.
